name: aws-cloud-fullstack-base
description: Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS DynamoDB base for the DDAC cloud application assignment.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace apps/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/frontend
